title: Continuity in the centre of blow-up integrals against a locally finite measure
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra) such that μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous with compact support, and let r > 0. Put η_{x,r}(y) := r⁻¹(y − x) (SimonGMT Chapter03.blowUpMap x r). Then the function x ↦ ∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y) is continuous on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Continuous (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ y, f (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ)
